senses.gloss: सित- + अंशुक सित- + अंशुक, adj., f. का, dressed in a white cloth.
सित- + इतर सित- + इतर, adj. black.

शित- + चम्पक शित- + चम्पक, m.
 1. a lamp. 2. a mirror.
सित- + छद सित- + छद, m. a goose.
सित- + दीधिति सित- + दीधिति and हिम-, m. the moon, Śiś. 9, 29.
सीता- + द्रव्य सीता- + द्रव्य, n. pl. implements of husbandry, Man. 9, 293.
सित- + मणि सित- + मणि, m. crystal, Megh. 67.
सित-मणि + मय सित-मणि + मय, adj. made of crystal, Megh. 67.
शीत- + मयूख शीत- + मयूख, m. 1. the moon. 2. camphor.
शीत- + रश्मि शीत- + रश्मि, m. the moon, Śṛṅgārat. 6.
शीत- + रुच् शीत- + रुच्, m. the moon, Śiś. 9, 25.
शितता शित + ता (see शो), f. Sharpness, Śiś. 9, 66.
शीतता शीत + ता, f. Coldness, Pañc. i. d. 287.
शिताभ्र शिताभ्र, see सिताभ्र.
सिताभ्र सिताभ्र, i. e. सित-अभ्र, m and n. (also सिताभ सिताभ, a dialect. form, m., and सिताभ्रक सिताभ्र + क, n.), Camphor (Indr. 1, 6, सिताभ्र, White clouds; MBh. 13, 836, शिताभ्र, White-clouded).

शिति शिति,
 I. adj.
 1. Black, dark blue, Vikr. d. 151; Bhāg. P. 4, 4, 18.
 2. White.
 II. m. The भूर्ज or birch.
शीत् शीत्, An imitative sound expressing pleasure, Bhartṛ. 1, 49 (cf. सीत्), and trembling, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 738.
सीत् सीत् (cf. शीत्), an imitative sound, expressing sighing, shivering with cold, murmuring, Rājat. 1, 213; cf. Nalod. 2, 62, Sch.

शीत शीत (probably an old ptcple. pf. pass. of शो),
 I. adj.
 1. Cold, Hit. i. d. 79, M.M.; chilly.
 2. A pathetic.
 3. Idle.
 4. Stupid.
 II. n.
 1. Coldness, Pañc. 169, 14.
 2. Water.
 --Comp.
शित शित (or सित-), m. 1. barley. 2. wheat.

सित सित,
 I. (cf. सि and सो), adj. White, Vikr. d. 53; Pañc. 158, 3.
 II. m.
 1. White (the colour).
 2. The light half of the month from new to full moon, Rājat. 5, 327.
 3. The planet Venus.
 4. An arrow.
 III. f. ता.
 1. Candied sugar.
 2. Moonlight.
 3. A handsome woman.
 4. Spirituous liquor.
 5. The name of several plants.
 IV. n.
 1. Silver.
 2. Sandal.
 --Comp.

सीता सीता (vb. सि), f.
 1. A furrow, the track of the ploughshare.
 2. Husbandry, Man. 9, 293.
 3. Name of a goddess, wife of Indra, presiding over fruits, etc., Pāraskara Gṛ. S. in Journ. of the German Oriental Society, vii. 538, 17.
 4. The wife of Rāma, Rām. 5, 48, 19.
 5. Lakṣmī.
 6. Umā.
 7. One of the fabulous branches of the Gaṅgā.
 8. Spirituous liquor.
 --Cf. सीत्य.

शीतल शीत + ल,
 I. adj. Cold, cool, Pañc. ii. d. 58; figurat., Vikr. d. 90. Comparat. ˚लतर, Cooler, Śiś. 9, 4.
 II. m.
 1. The moon.
 2. A sort of camphor.
 III. m., f. ला, and ली, and n. The name of several plants.
 IV. n.
 1. Coldness.
 2. A pearl.
 --Comp.

शीत्कार शीत्-कार, m.
 1. Making the sound शित्, sighing on account of pleasure.
 2. A frown. Amar. 31 (Sch.). []
 --Comp.
सित- + श्मश्रु सित- + श्मश्रु, adj. silvery-bearded.
सित- + सप्ति सित- + सप्ति, m. Arjuna, Kir. 13, 19.

सित-अ- + सित सित-अ- + सित,
 I. adj. white and black.
 II. m. a name of Baladeva.
सितिमन् सितिमन्, i. e. सित + इमन्, m. Whiteness, Śiś. 1, 25.

सीत्य सीत्य, i. e. सीत + य,
 I. adj. [] Tilled, ploughed.
 II. n. Corn, grain.
 --Cf. probably σῖτος.
